title: Placed Consumer Accounts Payment Schedule: Amount Figures and Channel Availability by Stage
content:
Payment Operations schedule for **Placed Consumer Accounts**. It lists, for each placement stage, the payment amount figures and the availability of the credit-card and retail cash payment network channels.

## Amount figures

| Stage | Minimum payment | Single card-payment maximum (debit or credit) | Rolling 30-day card-payment maximum | Single ACH bank-debit payment maximum | Single cash payment network maximum |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Early-Out Placement | $5.00 | $2500.00 | $5000.00 | $10000.00 | $0.00 (channel not accepted) |
| Primary Placement | $10.00 | $5000.00 | $10000.00 | $25000.00 | $1500.00 |
| Secondary Placement | $10.00 | $5000.00 | $10000.00 | $25000.00 | $1500.00 |
| Tertiary Placement | $10.00 | $3500.00 | $7500.00 | $25000.00 | $1000.00 |
| Warehouse Placement | $5.00 | $2500.00 | $5000.00 | $15000.00 | $1000.00 |
| Legal Review Placement | $25.00 | $10000.00 | $20000.00 | $50000.00 | $0.00 (channel not accepted) |

## Channel availability

| Stage | Credit cards accepted | Retail cash payment network accepted |
|---|---|---|
| Early-Out Placement | Yes | No |
| Primary Placement | Yes | Yes |
| Secondary Placement | Yes | Yes |
| Tertiary Placement | Yes | Yes |
| Warehouse Placement | Yes | Yes |
| Legal Review Placement | No | No |

## Definitions

- **Minimum payment**: the smallest single payment accepted unless the payment clears the full balance due.
- **Single card-payment maximum**: the largest single debit-card or credit-card payment, in USD.
- **Rolling 30-day card-payment maximum**: the largest total of card payments on one account in any rolling 30-day window, in USD.
- **Single ACH bank-debit payment maximum**: the largest single ACH bank-debit payment, in USD.
- **Single cash payment network maximum**: the largest single retail cash payment network payment, in USD; it reads $0.00 at the stages where that channel is not accepted.

## Points of comparison

- Legal Review Placement has the highest amount figures but accepts neither credit cards nor the retail cash payment network.
- Early-Out Placement accepts credit cards but not the retail cash payment network.
- At every stage the rolling 30-day card-payment maximum is twice the single card-payment maximum, except at Tertiary Placement, where it is $7500.00 against $3500.00.
